start.headline: Enrollment, signed without a stack of paper.
start.body: Here's how your enrollment agreement goes out, gets signed and comes back, all online.

steps.alt: Document templates with the Enrollment Agreement
steps.title: Your agreement, ready to send
steps.body: Your enrollment agreement is saved as a template. Send it to any family in a few clicks, from their record or from an automation.

steps.alt: The Enrollment Agreement signed by Elena Ramirez
steps.title: Parents sign from any device
steps.body: The Ramirez family opened the link on their phone, signed and dated it. No printer, no scanner, no trip to the front office.

steps.alt: The Completed tab with the signed Enrollment Agreement
steps.title: You know the moment it's signed
steps.body: Signed agreements move to Completed, and the signed copy stays on the family's record.

finish.headline: Signed, dated and filed on the family's record.
finish.body: No printing, scanning or chasing signatures. You know the moment a family commits.
